mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (username, password, name, email, phone) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, name, email, phone, token, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, NOW(), token_expires_at) AS session_seconds_left FROM member WHERE token = #{token} AND token_expires_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET token = #{token}, token_expires_at = CASE WHEN #{token} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NOW() + INTERVAL ${@com.example.demo.service.AuthService@SESSION_MINUTES} MINUTE END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE member SET token_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL ${@com.example.demo.service.AuthService@SESSION_MINUTES} MINUTE WHERE id = #{id} AND token IS NOT NULL
UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, token = NULL, token_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
